checklist.detail: The preburner drive gas cannot power the pumps at this chamber pressure: best achievable power margin 0.92 (oxidizer-rich PR 2.68 @ 628 K (margin 0.92)) with the turbine PR searched up to 3.0. A hotter preburner (preburner temperature inputs), better turbomachinery, or a lower Pc closes it - this is the staged-cycle Pc ceiling [SP-8107 Table VI].

checklist.detail: Turbine PR 2.68 / drive-pump discharge 3.56 x Pc is outside real staged-combustion practice (PR < ~2.0, SSME 1.56-1.59; discharge ~2.1-2.3 x Pc - SSME/RD-0124/NK-33) - the turbine is being asked for an unusually large pressure drop.

checklist.detail: Oxidizer-rich staged combustion needs an oxidizer-resistant turbine (hot O2-rich gas is highly corrosive/erosive) - historically achieved reliably only by late-Soviet/Russian engines (RD-170 family). Treat reliability figures as optimistic for other eras/manufacturers.

checklist.detail: NARloy-Z Copper Alloy (Cu-Ag-Zr): computed wall temp 1088 K EXCEEDS its 800 K max service temp (Tc 3893 K, regenerative cooling). Marginal/unsuitable as designed. Basis: coupled throat wall balance: gas h_g ~20.7 kW/m2K incl. carbon-deposit credit, T_aw ~3839 K, coolant ~37 m/s (coolant-side wall ~1000 K), 0.50 mm wall. Levers that lower it: faster coolant (Coolant velocity; SP-8087 caps liquids at ~61 m/s, at a jacket-dP cost), a thinner wall, a liner rated hotter or more conductive (e.g. GRCop-84), or more film cooling.

checklist.detail: Hottest wall station is in the convergent section (area ratio ~1.0, regen): wall ~1119 K, 0.71x that section's material limit (warns below 1.15x, like the throat row). Levers: more chamber film (or a convergent film ring for the throat region), faster coolant, a thinner or more conductive liner, or extend active cooling.

checklist.detail: Resultant injection beta angle +6.0 deg is outside the -2 to +6 deg band LOX/RP-1 prefers - it wants a slightly negative beta (~0 or below). Adjust the impingement angle or element momentum ratio.
checklist.name: Injector resultant beta angle

checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~1785 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.15 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: Near the end of active cooling (area ratio ~36.9), estimated jacket/coolant pressure (~31.6 MPa) exceeds local hot-gas static pressure (~0.1 MPa) - the net load on the channel-land wall there REVERSES direction. Modeled as a clamped-strip bending stress across the ~18.3 mm channel width, this reversed ~31.6 MPa differential is ~17661 MPa against a ~133 MPa allowable (Inconel 718 Nickel Superalloy, SF 1.5) - but this is a coarse clamped-plate-strip proxy, NOT a real buckling/FEA analysis, and this codebase has no real-engine spot check for it yet. Treat this as 'worth a closer structural look', not a validated failure prediction. Consider more/narrower channels (smaller span), tapering the actively-cooled length, or a thicker wall there.
checklist.name: Jacket overpressure vs. channel-wall structural margin
